codeReview.summary: The dead code removal was thoroughly implemented and successfully completed. All 4 requirements from the feature description have been fully satisfied.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker followed the nixos-config-worker skill procedure correctly. Used proper validation steps with nix flake check after each change, verified behavioral equivalence, and committed changes appropriately.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows proper sequence: read files → make changes → validate with nix flake check → verify no duplicates → remove commented imports → remove backup files → final validation. Handoff shows skillFeedback.followedProcedure = true with no deviations.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly used NixOS declarative principles by only editing configuration files (/etc/nixos/) and never modifying the Nix store directly. All changes were made through proper NixOS module configuration.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Git status shows changes only to tracked configuration files: modules/common-host.nix (deleted), modules/default.nix (modified), and stale .backup/.disabled files (deleted). No imperative system modifications were made.

sharedStateObservations.observation: No new services were started that should be documented in services.yaml - this was purely a configuration cleanup task.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The work involved only file modifications and deletions, no service initialization or runtime changes.
